images.name: k1_master_A.png
images.prompt: Keeper of Hours — STARTER identity master. One full-body figure, facing the camera (direction S), projection C (elevated three-quarter), standing, feet visible, weight even, arms relaxed with the rod held upright in the RIGHT hand. Identity: a young archivist, early 20s, dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned skin, face fully visible, no helmet. Costume (every item is an instrument or carries one): ivory linen shirt with rolled sleeves under a navy wool sleeveless tabard; ONE chestnut leather harness strap running from the right shoulder diagonally to the LEFT hip where it carries an olive waxed-canvas satchel with brass corners; ONE chestnut leather waist belt whose buckle closes the tabard; chestnut leather laced bracers on both forearms; navy wool trousers; chestnut leather buckled boots. Weapon: an astrolabe-rod — a dark walnut shaft with a BRASS RING HEAD; the ring carries a single radial hour-mark. Signature motif: the same single open ring with one radial hour-mark appears EXACTLY ONCE on the tabard chest panel and once as the rod head, and NOWHERE ELSE — every other surface is plain and undecorated: no trim, no edge ornament, no secondary sigils, no compass diagrams, no studs. Register: painted 2D, illustrated, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, no conspicuous brush or pixel grain. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on the key-facing edge; no spell glow; NO floor shadow. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; do not matte. Image 1 is a STYLE reference for the painted register only — do not copy its figure, its costume, its emblems or its ornament.

references.role: STYLE reference for painted register only; do not copy figure, costume, emblems or ornament

concerns: The verbatim task prompt produced single-figure 1024×1536 identity masters, not the register's 1254-square sheets or registered 512-square frames. Originals were copied without modification as requested.
Exact projection C constants and pixel-exact background uniformity were not verified.
Natural variation includes costume hardware and facial differences; candidate C's chest hour-mark extends outside its ring and its rod leans slightly.
